title: load_group_commands reads the it_ops_kb.backlog_commands entry point before extension_paths are on sys.path, so a distribution installed under an extension_paths directory is missed
goal: load_group_commands finds an it_ops_kb.backlog_commands entry point whose distribution sits under a directory of extension_paths, as the other extension points do

run:
import json,os,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
site=T/"site"; (site/"gx-0.1.dist-info").mkdir(parents=True)
(site/"gx-0.1.dist-info"/"METADATA").write_text("Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: gx\nVersion: 0.1\n")
(site/"gx-0.1.dist-info"/"entry_points.txt").write_text("[it_ops_kb.backlog_commands]\ngx = gcmds\n")
(site/"gcmds.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=0.1\"\nimport bl_cli\nbl_cli.register(\"hello\", lambda a: print(\"hi\"))\n")
(T/"ws").mkdir()
(T/"ws"/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extension_paths":[str(site)]}))
import bl_cli
bl_cli.load_group_commands(T/"ws")
sys.exit(0 if "hello" in bl_cli.COMMANDS else "not yet: an entry point under extension_paths loaded no command")
